note: The sound graph (doc 17, with doc 24's music bus). buses: the default level of each bus (0..1) before the player's settings scale it; music defaults to 0.7 (doc 24). The game's settings slice does not have a music level yet, so the mixer uses musicDefault until it does (docs/audio-future-work.md). compressor: the gentle master limiter (dB, ratio, seconds). fades: seconds for the master fade in after the first touch, the fade out when the tab hides, and the fade in when it returns. island reverb: the shared outdoor air for ambience and creatures, about 1.2 s, made from filtered noise (no file); decayS is the time to fall 60 dB, hfDecayS how fast the highs fall (shorter is darker), sends per bus, preDelayMs. music reverb: the music's own room (doc 24), about 2.6 s and darker, with early reflections at the listed milliseconds (gain each, alternating left and right), and a wet level; it is never shared with the island. musicTone: the music bus's starting brightness (lowpass Hz), and the chorus EQ (a gentle dip near frog calls, doc 24) at hz with q and its dB when frogs are near (0 when not). duck: how far the music dips near a calling creature (dB) and the attack and release seconds. mobile: what changes on the mobile tier (reverbs at half length, doc 17). seed: the fixed seed for the reverb noise, so the room sounds the same every time. Music level 0.5 and music room 0.30 are Matt's headphone reference from the bench (October 19, 2026), heard with the piano alone; revisit both against the island in phase 6.
